tests.name: Clean build
tests.assertion: npm run android:debug from a clean tree exits 0 and produces the debug APK (size + sha256 recorded)

tests.name: APK facts
tests.assertion: aapt2: package com.kissansahyog.app, label "Kisan Sahyog", minSdk 24, targetSdk 36, versionName 0.1.0, debuggable, permissions exactly the decided set
tests.notes: permissions: ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, INTERNET, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS, RECORD_AUDIO, com.kissansahyog.app.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION

tests.name: Bundle safety
tests.assertion: APK web assets: production ref present; staging ref/host, service_role, GEMINI_API_KEY, sb_secret all absent; packaged capacitor.config has no server.url (counts only)
tests.notes: 121 text files scanned; prod ref ×1; bare "sb_secret" literal ×1 = supabase-js key-type check, not a key

tests.name: Install + cold start
tests.assertion: After install and am start -W: process alive at 10 s, no FATAL EXCEPTION, page is https://localhost/, text contains "किसान", screenshot is not blank
tests.notes: am start -W: Status: ok, WaitTime 11946 ms (the emulator renders on a software GPU); title "किसान सहयोग — मंडी भाव, मौसम, योजनाएं व बाज़ार"

tests.name: Routes render
tests.assertion: 15 routes + 1 invalid path: main content renders, no ErrorBoundary, no uncaught page error, no console.error outside the documented allowlist
tests.notes: 16/16 routes ok; 32 allow-listed console errors (CORS to the live site, needs deploy)

tests.name: Deep link + reload
tests.assertion: Direct navigation to /yojana/central and a real /sawaal/<slug>, then reload: the same page renders (SPA fallback)

tests.name: Live data (read-only)
tests.assertion: /mausam, /msp, the mandi ticker on / and the listings on /browse load real data: HTTP 200 from the data host AND non-empty values in the DOM
tests.notes: No mandi-api.onrender.com call exists in the client (prices come from Supabase); /browse has no ticker, so its listings are checked instead. /mausam needs a place: Sagar was set as the saved location (the page then upserts its weather-grid request, as it does for any visitor).

tests.name: No service worker
tests.assertion: navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() is empty, no update/install banner in the DOM, sw.js is absent from the APK

tests.name: Edge-to-edge / safe areas
tests.assertion: API 36 portrait: NavBar below the status bar, tab bar buttons above the navigation bar and not covered, offline banner below the status bar, last footer link fully visible above the tab bar
tests.notes: window padded by Capacitor (CSS insets 0); status bar bottom 136px, navigation bar top 2337px, dpr 2.625; the edge-to-edge CSS path was also checked with simulated insets

tests.name: Offline
tests.assertion: Airplane mode + cold launch: app shell renders (not a browser error page), offline banner visible, no crash; /, /browse, /mausam, /msp, /about show content or an in-app failure state; back online the banner goes within 15 s and /mausam loads data
tests.notes: offline via cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable. What each page shows offline (input for batch 8B) — /: 4606 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 16, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0 || /browse: 1096 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 0, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0 || /mausam: 1431 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 0, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 1 || /msp: 4539 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 29, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0 || /about: 2605 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 0, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0

tests.name: Back button
tests.assertion: / → /browse → /bazaar, back, back lands on /; back on / leaves the app (launcher resumed) — adb keyevent 4 + dumpsys activity

tests.name: External intents
tests.assertion: A real external https link leaves the WebView and returning shows the same in-app page; a mailto: and a tel: link dispatch their intents
tests.notes: https: RAN-PASSED → com.android.chrome/org.chromium.chrome.browser.firstrun.FirstRunActivity | mailto: RAN-PASSED → com.google.android.gm/.welcome.WelcomeTourActivity | tel: RAN-PASSED → com.google.android.dialer/com.android.dialer.main.impl.MainActivity

tests.name: Location
tests.assertion: With location permission granted and the emulator position set, "Share my location" shows that place; with permission refused the app shows its fallback state without crashing
tests.notes: refusal given through no dialog (WebView answered directly)

tests.name: Keyboard + search
tests.assertion: On /search a tap opens the keyboard, the input stays inside the visual viewport, and a query known to have results renders results
tests.notes: FAILED: the viewport shrank for the keyboard ({"viewportHeight":839.2380981445312,"screenHeight":915}) | query "wheat" → 16 results

tests.name: Persistence
tests.assertion: A localStorage value set over CDP survives force-stop + relaunch (then it is deleted)

tests.name: Icon + splash
tests.assertion: Launcher icons at all densities + adaptive-icon XML exist and are packaged; launcher and splash screenshots captured for a person to judge
tests.notes: File checks passed; whether the icon and splash LOOK right needs a person (see launcher-app-list.jpg and splash-frame-*.jpg).

tests.name: Server calls + CORS
tests.assertion: (a) no raw relative fetch() to a server function is left in src/; (b) functions/_middleware.js answers OPTIONS/GET with the exact origin for the two app origins and adds nothing for other origins
tests.notes: Live end-to-end CORS against production is NOT-RUN: functions/_middleware.js only takes effect after a deploy, which this batch does not do.

tests.name: Web regression
tests.assertion: (a) apiUrl()/isNative() are inert without Capacitor; (b) the web build succeeds; (c) main-chunk size before vs after is reported; (d) vite preview in desktop Chromium loads, registers a service worker, no console errors
tests.notes: main chunk 72.2 KB → 78.8 KB (+6797 B; gzip +2148 B), measured in a temporary worktree of staging 206cd86

tests.name: Negative control
tests.assertion: An injected false assertion is reported RAN-FAILED and the script exits non-zero; a non-existent device serial makes every device test NOT-RUN (nothing passes)
tests.notes: false assertion → RAN-FAILED (exit 1); bad serial → T4 NOT-RUN, T5 NOT-RUN, T8 NOT-RUN, T15 NOT-RUN (exit 0, NOT-RUN does not fail a run)

tests.name: Repeatability
tests.assertion: scripts/test-android.sh --flavor prod run twice back to back gives the same status for every test (durations may differ)

tests.name: Prod-flavour regression
tests.assertion: The prod APK is rebuilt and T1–T20 run again read-only: no RAN-FAILED test
